# ledger Provider

Manage a [Ledger](https://github.com/aurimasniekis/go-ledger) server through its Management API.

Each setting can also come from the environment. **Precedence** (first one set wins, and an unusable source is an error rather than a fall-through): `endpoint` attribute, then `LEDGER_ENDPOINT`; `token` attribute, then `token_file` attribute, then `LEDGER_TOKEN`, then `LEDGER_TOKEN_FILE`. Blank values count as unset. On configuration the provider reads the API version the server serves and refuses a server on an unsupported major version (ADR-0008).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials normally come from the environment (LEDGER_ENDPOINT, LEDGER_TOKEN or LEDGER_TOKEN_FILE),
# so an empty block is enough.
provider "ledger" {}

# Or set them explicitly. Prefer token_file over token so the secret stays out of configuration files.
provider "ledger" {
  alias      = "explicit"
  endpoint   = "https://ledger.example.com"
  token_file = "/run/secrets/ledger-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Ledger server, for example `https://ledger.example.com`. Falls back to the `LEDGER_ENDPOINT` environment variable. Must be an http or https URL without credentials, query or fragment. Use https for any non-local server.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Ledger API token. Falls back to `token_file`, then the `LEDGER_TOKEN` environment variable, then `LEDGER_TOKEN_FILE`. Prefer the environment or `token_file` so the token is not written into configuration files. Conflicts with `token_file`.
- `token_file` (String) Path to a file that contains only the API token (one line; surrounding whitespace is ignored). Falls back to the `LEDGER_TOKEN_FILE` environment variable when neither `token` nor `token_file` is set and `LEDGER_TOKEN` is empty. Conflicts with `token`.
